Class ResourceHandlerChestStorage

java.lang.Object
net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.transaction.SnapshotJournal<DeepSlot[]>
org.cyclops.colossalchests2.capability.ResourceHandlerChestStorage
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.ResourceHandler<net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.item.ItemResource>
public class ResourceHandlerChestStorage extends net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.transaction.SnapshotJournal<DeepSlot[]> implements net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.ResourceHandler<net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.item.ItemResource>
NeoForge item resource handler on a chest storage, with long amounts and transaction support. A transaction snapshots all slots, so an aborted transaction leaves the storage untouched. Views for walls share the snapshots of the core's handler, so one transaction through several walls rolls back correctly. Single operations are limited to Integer.MAX_VALUE, but getAmountAsLong(int) and getCapacityAsLong(int, ItemResource) report the full values.
